subject: IRP evidence access & contract exception request
messages:
From: Sophie Alderson <sophie.alderson@clearharbor.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Mike Sanders <mike.sanders@clearharbor.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request for IRP artifacts and post-incident summary

Hi Lauren,

Following last week's brief notify that Redwood experienced a brief service disruption on 2027-05-03, ClearHarbor's security and procurement teams need to complete our vendor security review. Can you provide: 

- The IRP (Incident Response Plan) or pointer to the canonical control document (SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ section references)
- A sanitized post-incident summary for the May 3 event (high-level timeline, root cause, mitigation) we can include in our internal memo
- An evidence index describing available artifacts (logs, snapshots, redacted telemetry) and options for temporary secure access (S3 presigned link, secure share)

We recognize some artifacts are sensitive. If needed we can sign an exception/NDA and limit retention. Our third-party auditor (Audita Security) will review the sanitized packet and confirm it meets our audit requirements.

Attaching the vendor questionnaire CSV to show what fields we need. Appreciate a rough ETA — procurement wants to close this vendor check by next Friday (2027-05-14).

Thanks,
Sophie Alderson
Security Lead, ClearHarbor Financial
Attachments: clearharbor_vendor_questionnaire.csv
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:34:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request for IRP artifacts and post-incident summary

Marissa / Jonas — FYI inbound from ClearHarbor (Sophie + Mike). They want the IRP, a sanitized postmortem for the 5/3 disruption, and an evidence index. They explicitly offered to sign an NDA/exception for temporary access. Procurement wants closure by 5/14.

Questions:
1) Can we provide a sanitized postmortem + evidence index by 5/12?
2) What approvals do we need for a temporary S3 presigned access or DocuSign exception?
3) Any sensitivity or legal concerns we should flag to the customer now?

I'm happy to lead the customer comms once we have the plan.

— Lauren
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:06:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for IRP artifacts and post-incident summary

Thanks, Lauren.

We can comply with the request but will follow the standard sanitized delivery process:

Planned deliverables (target 2027-05-12):
- IRP reference doc (PDF) with SOC 2 control mappings (high-level only).
- Sanitized postmortem (PDF) — redacted runbooks, timeline, root cause, mitigations, and remediation owners.
- Evidence index (CSV) listing artifact types and retained windows.
- Temporary secure access option: S3 presigned objects (48-hour TTL) or a secure read-only Share (recorded download).

Approval path:
- Security (me) approves sanitized content and redaction level.
- Legal must sign a limited-scope exception / NDA for access to logs containing customer identifiers (Jonas, can you confirm preferred DocuSign template?).
- Product/Engineering to approve retained telemetry export (I'll loop in infra if needed).

Notes on sensitivity: raw telemetry and full auth traces contain customer PII and tenant IDs — we will not release raw traces. We will provide prefiltered artifacts and a short forensic timeline. If Audita requires full traces, they must sign the exception and we will provide a time-limited, fully-audited transfer under an approved SOW.

I've attached an evidence_index_stub with the fields we'll populate. Once Legal / Product confirm, I can prepare the sanitized PDF and presigned bundle.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: evidence_index_stub_20270508.csv
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 13:02:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for IRP artifacts and post-incident summary

Lauren / Marissa,

Legal is fine with a short NDA / limited-access exception to enable evidence review. Procurement teams commonly want a signed agreement; we'll use our standard "Evidence Access Addendum" DocuSign template. I'll draft and push to DocuSign today.

Operational points:
- Keep redaction to remove tenant identifiers and any customer PII.
- Limit retention of shared artifacts to 48–72 hours.
- Add logging + access auditing (we'll capture download events).

If ClearHarbor's auditor requests granular logs beyond prefiltered artifacts, escalate to Sales leadership for an SOW. Jonas -> I'll attach the DocuSign link in the outgoing comm once it's ready.

— Jonas Weber
VP Legal & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Alderson <sophie.alderson@clearharbor.com>, Mike Sanders <mike.sanders@clearharbor.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, thirdparty-audits@audita.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:21:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for IRP artifacts and post-incident summary

Hi Sophie / Mike — thanks for the details and timeline. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) DocuSign NDA / Evidence Access Addendum: Jonas has initiated a DocuSign packet. Please sign here: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=ABC123-clearharbor-irp (expected TTL: 72 hours after signing).

2) Deliverables & ETA: we will provide the following by 2027-05-12: 
   - Redwood_IRP_reference.pdf (SOC 2 control crosswalk; high-level)
   - sanitized_postmortem_draft_v1.pdf (redacted timeline & remediation)
   - evidence_index_20270512.csv (artifact list and available access methods)

3) Access model: once the DocuSign is executed, Security will prepare a time-limited S3 bundle (48-hour presigned links) and enable access logging. If Audita requires a deeper review, we'll evaluate an SOW.

4) Redaction policy summary: PII and tenant IDs will be removed from any artifacts. We will provide a one-page appendix describing redaction choices.

Attachments: clearharbor_irp_questions_20270507.pdf (we received this from your procurement), evidence_index_stub_20270508.csv

Please confirm when the DocuSign is signed and any constraints from Audita's side. We'll queue the sanitized packet for delivery immediately after signature.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
